task_production_rates.name: Inspect Primed Ceiling Surface
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Walking inspection overhead with work light, marking defects. Slower than wall inspection.

task_production_rates.name: Inspect Primed Ceiling Surface (Premium)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Detailed overhead inspection with bright work light, marking all defects

task_production_rates.name: Inspect Primed Ceiling Surface (Critical)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Critical inspection with raking light, multiple passes. Semi-gloss+ shows everything.

task_production_rates.name: Spackle Ceiling Imperfections
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Overhead spackle application with extension pole applicator. Rate reflects typical defect density.

task_production_rates.name: Spackle Ceiling Imperfections (Critical)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Critical spackle work with wide feathering, multiple thin coats as needed. Slower for semi-gloss prep.

task_production_rates.name: Sand Spackled Areas on Ceiling
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Pole sander on spackled areas, blend into surrounding surface

task_production_rates.name: Sand Spackled Areas on Ceiling (Critical)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Critical sanding to perfection, wet sponge test for smoothness. Semi-gloss shows every flaw.

task_production_rates.name: Spot Prime Spackled Areas on Ceiling
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Spot prime spackled areas with brush to seal repairs before finish coat

task_production_rates.name: Vacuum Repair Dust from Ceiling
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Overhead vacuum with extension pole and brush attachment

task_production_rates.name: Light Sand Entire Primed Ceiling
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Pole sander with 220 grit, light even pass overhead

task_production_rates.name: Light Sand Entire Primed Ceiling (Critical)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Thorough sanding with raking light inspection. Critical for semi-gloss+.

task_production_rates.name: Vacuum Sanding Dust from Ceiling
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: HEPA vacuum with brush attachment overhead

task_production_rates.name: Verify/Apply Window Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Verify existing masking or apply new. Faster than initial mask if already in place.

task_production_rates.name: Verify/Apply Door Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Verify existing masking or apply new. Doors larger than windows.

task_production_rates.name: Protect Ceiling Fixtures
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Stuff and tape ~8 items per room (6 lights + 2 ceiling boxes average). ~15 min per room.

task_production_rates.name: Roll Ceiling Finish Coat 1
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: 18-inch roller with extension pole overhead. Finish coat slightly slower than primer.

task_production_rates.name: Roll Ceiling Finish Coat 1 (Textured)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Textured ceiling requires more product and slower application overhead

task_production_rates.name: Light Sand Between Coats
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Light sand first coat with 220 grit pole sander before second coat

task_production_rates.name: Light Sand Between Coats (Critical)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Careful sanding with inspection between coats. Critical for semi-gloss+.

task_production_rates.name: Vacuum Intercoat Sanding Dust
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Vacuum sanding dust before second coat

task_production_rates.name: Roll Ceiling Finish Coat 2
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Second coat same technique as first coat

task_production_rates.name: Spray Ceiling Finish Coat 1
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Airless spray overhead, coupled to backroll rate. Spray at this rate, backroll limits system.

task_production_rates.name: Backroll Ceiling Finish Coat 1
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: 18-inch roller overhead, sets pace for spray+backroll system. This is the bottleneck.

task_production_rates.name: Spray Ceiling Finish Coat 2
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Second spray coat, same technique

task_production_rates.name: Backroll Ceiling Finish Coat 2
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Second backroll coat, same technique

task_production_rates.name: Spray Ceiling Finish (No Backroll)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Spray-only overhead, no backroll coupling constraint. Higher overlap required.

task_production_rates.name: Vacuum Subfloors
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shop vacuum of subfloor to remove paint drips and debris

task_production_rates.name: Remove Ceiling Fixture Protection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Remove paper and tape from ceiling fixtures. Faster than setup.

task_production_rates.name: Clean Tools
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Fixed time per job to clean brushes, rollers, spray equipment

task_production_rates.name: Final Ceiling Inspection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Walking inspection of completed ceiling work

task_production_rates.name: Final Ceiling Inspection (Premium)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Detailed inspection with work light, touch up any defects

task_production_rates.name: Final Ceiling Inspection (Critical)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Critical inspection under raking light. Semi-gloss+ is unforgiving.

quality_tier_effects.description: Economy ceiling paint - reduced prep, basic coverage, flat finish
quality_tier_effects.notes: Economy work: skip inspection/repair, single coat flat, basic final check

quality_tier_effects.description: Standard ceiling paint - baseline for all rates
quality_tier_effects.notes: Standard NC: inspection/repair, single coat flat white, thorough final check

quality_tier_effects.description: Premium ceiling paint (flat) - two coats flat for color or enhanced coverage
quality_tier_effects.notes: Premium flat: thorough prep, two coats flat (typically for colored ceilings), detailed inspection. No sheen penalty.

quality_tier_effects.description: Premium ceiling paint (eggshell/satin) - two coats with sheen
quality_tier_effects.notes: Premium eggshell: thorough prep, light sand full ceiling, two coats eggshell/satin. Sheen on ceiling requires more careful application.

quality_tier_effects.description: Critical ceiling paint - semi-gloss+ finish, two coats, critical prep and inspection
quality_tier_effects.notes: Critical work: semi-gloss+ on ceiling is extremely demanding. Slows ALL tasks significantly. Every imperfection shows.

sheen_application_effects.description: Flat paint is forgiving on ceilings - baseline application time
sheen_application_effects.notes: Flat hides imperfections, lap marks blend, touch-up is easy

sheen_application_effects.description: Eggshell/satin on ceilings requires 18% more time per SF
sheen_application_effects.notes: Sheen shows lap marks and application inconsistency. Must maintain wet edge, work more carefully overhead.

sheen_application_effects.description: Semi-gloss+ on ceilings requires 43% more time per SF
sheen_application_effects.notes: High sheen is unforgiving on overhead surfaces. Lap marks, roller marks, drips all show. Requires perfect technique.

texture_effects.notes: Orange peel texture increases surface area ~15%, slows application ~15%
Knockdown texture increases surface area ~25%, slows application ~20%

coupling_constraints.description: When using spray+backroll on ceilings, spray rate must not exceed backroll rate. Backroller sets the pace.
coupling_constraints.practical_implication: Spray at 450 SF/hr, backroll at 320 SF/hr means effective ceiling rate is 320 SF/hr per crew
coupling_constraints.notes: Spray and backroll done by 2-person crew working in tandem, bottleneck is backroll

crew_configurations.name: Ceiling Roller
crew_configurations.notes: One person does all ceiling rolling with extension pole

crew_configurations.name: Spray + Backroll Ceiling Crew
crew_configurations.notes: Sprayer and backroller work in tandem. Backroller sets pace.

overhead_factor.description: Ceiling work is inherently slower than equivalent wall work due to neck angle, arm fatigue, and working overhead
overhead_factor.notes: Ceiling rates are approximately 15% slower than equivalent wall work rates

height_effects.notes: Standard residential/light commercial ceiling height. Extension pole from floor.
Taller ceilings require longer extension poles, more fatigue, slightly slower pace.
May require step ladder or scaffolding for some tasks. Increased setup and repositioning.
Scaffolding or lift required. Significant setup time, repositioning, and safety considerations.
Scissor lift or scaffolding tower required. Major equipment setup, safety protocols, slower work pace.
